sequenceReserved.markdownDescription:
List of terms to ignore when scanning symbol tokens

Defines a list of terms that to ignore when searching for the symbol tokens constituting an TenXTemplate's 'message' portion (i.e., the [symbol](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/structure/#symbols) tokens of the origin ranked highest by coverage, meaning the count of distinct library-known tokens it explains; span length is the last tiebreak). For example, for an TenXObject whose text contains: 'connect success = true', the value 'true' will not be considered a part of the instance's message, as it is mostly likely the result of a variable boolean state. To learn more see [symbolSequence](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXObject+symbolSequence). (Default: ["null","nil","true","false"])

enclosures.markdownDescription:
Pairs of open and close characters whose text before the message is envelope

Defines the enclosures of a line's preamble, each an open and a close character. A word inside one of them before the message (e.g., 'main' in '[main] Starting worker') is envelope and stays out of the TenXTemplate's message name. An open with no close after it in the same field encloses nothing, such as the '[' of a color code ('\033[0;33mWARN') or one that closes on a later line of a multi-line event. The message starts at the first word that no part of the preamble describes: not [reserved](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolsequencereserved), not a [message key](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolpreamblemessagekeys), not enclosed and not a reserved key or its value. (Default: ["[]","()"])

assigners.markdownDescription:
Characters that bind a key to its value when the key or the value is quoted

Defines the characters that bind a key to its value, one character each, when the key or the value is quoted (e.g., '"level":"info"', "body: 'Charge request received.'"). A [reserved](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolsequencereserved) key and its value are envelope; the message starts inside a [message key](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolpreamblemessagekeys)'s value. Unquoted, a colon binds nothing, so 'Error: 13 INTERNAL' and 'INFO:root:Starting' keep their words. (Default: ["=",":"])

bareAssigners.markdownDescription:
Characters that also bind an unquoted key to an unquoted value

Defines the assigners that bind a key without quotes, one character each, as logfmt writes them (e.g., 'level=info', 'logger=cleanup'). An assigner listed here binds in record form too. (Default: ["="])

joiners.markdownDescription:
Separators that chain words into one name, read to find a group's lead

Defines the separators that chain two or more words, written without whitespace, into one name (e.g., 'org.apache.kafka.log.LocalLog', 'cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore'), typically a logger, class or file name. They decide only which member of a multi-line event names it: a member whose every word is such a name or other envelope does not lead the group (see [symbolGroupLead](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolgrouplead)). In a message name a joined name stays, as a logger or class name is often the only text that tells two statements apart. (Default: [".","::"])

messageKeys.markdownDescription:
Keys whose bound value holds the message

Defines the keys whose value holds the message. The message starts at the value's first word the preamble does not describe (e.g., 'starting' in 'msg=starting', 'Subchannel' in '"msg":"[core][Channel #1] Subchannel created"', 'Charge' in "body: 'Charge request received.'"). In a record that opens with '{', reading starts at the first message key with a value. A message key without a value is envelope, as a reserved word is. (Default: ["msg","message","body"])

groupLead.markdownDescription:
Member of a multi-line group whose text names the group

Selects the member of a multi-line event group whose text names it. 'firstWithMessage' names a group from its first member whose input field is not all envelope, a name of words chained by a [joiner](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolpreamblejoiners) counting as envelope here, so a head such as the .NET console logger's 'info: cart.cartstore.ValkeyCartStore[0]' before the record holding the message leaves the name, origin and skeleton to that record. A head that holds a message (e.g., a stack trace's exception line) names the group. 'head' always names a group from its head. (Default: firstWithMessage)

maxOrigins.markdownDescription:
Max number of source/binary origins to list per symbol

Controls the number of source code/binary origins to list per symbol token sequence. As a series of tokens within  a given template (e.g., 'ERROR', 'could not connect to "{}') may appear  in multiple source/binary files within the pipeline's symbol files, the sorting algorithm selects [maxSymbolOrigins](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symbolmaxorigins) for comparison. (Accepts number or string with $= prefix for runtime evaluation) (Default: 64)

origins.markdownDescription:
List of source scanned file names for which to log information

Specifies a list of input file names within the loaded symbol library (e.g., 'my.scala', 'foo.java') for which to log information on if/how they participate in selecting the origin of a target TenXTemplate symbol sequence. This option helps debug how the [symbolSequence](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXObject+symbolSequence) function selects  origin values for a target TenXTemplate symbol sequence.  Specify '*' for all input files.

symbols.markdownDescription:
List of TenXTemplate symbol values for which to log information

List of symbol values such as class and method names(e.g., 'MyClass', 'foo') for which to log information on how their origin information is selected. This option helps debug how the [symbolSequence](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXObject+symbolSequence) function selects  origin values for a target TenXTemplate symbol sequence.  Specify '*' for all symbols.

loggerName.markdownDescription:
Debug logger name

Controls the name of the log4j logger used by [debugOrigins](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symboldebugorigins) and [debugSymbols](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#symboldebugsymbols). (Default: [consoleOut](https://github.com/log-10x/config/blob/main/log4j2.yaml#L66))
